REPORT
Date February 28, 19 40.

Subject COROT, Anatole Joseph alias KOROTH - communication from "Y" dated
February 22, 1940.

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

（批：Copy sent to 'D'）

Anatole Joseph Corot, Russian Jew registered
at the offices of the Russian Emigrants' Committee,
Shanghai, was born in Irkutsk on September 7, 1910.
He received his education at Liege University,
Belgium, from whence he graduated in economic
science.

In 1932 Corot left Europe and came to
Shanghai where he was successful in obtaining
a clerical position with S.E. Levy & Company,
Investment Bankers and Brokers. He remained in
Shanghai until 1937 when in company with R.O.
KOPELMAN, he was sent as representative of his
firm to Singapore where, it is stated, he is
still resident.

While there is nothing detrimental concerning
A.J. Corot in Police records, there is, however,
certain data concerning his father, Joseph R.
KOROTH, who, while in Shanghai, is suspected of
having been employed as a political agent by the
Soviet Government. Koroth is now living in Harbin,
having absconded from Shanghai in 1939 in order to
escape his creditors to whom he owed a considerable
amount of money.

报告
日期：1940年2月28日。

主题：COROT, Anatole Joseph，别名 KOROTH —— 来自“Y”的函件，日期为1940年2月22日。

制作人：D.S. Henchman 转呈人：D. I. Crawford

（批注：副本已送交‘D’）

Anatole Joseph Corot，俄罗斯犹太人，已在上海俄罗斯移民委员会办公室登记，于1910年9月7日出生于伊尔库茨克。他在比利时列日大学接受教育，并毕业于经济学专业。

1932年，Corot 离开欧洲来到上海，成功在 S.E. Levy & Company（投资银行家与经纪人）获得一份职员职位。他留在上海直至1937年，当时他与 R.O. KOPELMAN 一同被其公司派往新加坡担任代表，据称他目前仍居住在那里。

虽然警方档案中没有任何关于 A.J. Corot 的不利记录，但是，有关其父亲 Joseph R. KOROTH 的某些资料却显示，约瑟夫·R·科罗斯在上海期间，被怀疑受苏联政府雇佣充当政治代理人。Koroth 现居哈尔滨，他于1939年从上海潜逃，以躲避向其追讨巨额债务的债权人。

（批注：x 另见档案：-

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8021
S.I, Special Branch 2/Std/ldly, 37
REPORT
Date July 19, 19 37

Subject S.E. Levy & Co. - Enquiry from British Consulate-General.

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by G Crawford D.S.

The firm of S.E. Levy & Co., 113 Kiukiang Road,
investment bankers and brokers in securities and commodities,
was established under that name in July, 1933; prior to this
the concern was known as V. Gensburger & Co.

This Company for the greater part composed of Jews,
is of good financial standing and enjoy an excellent reputation
both here and in financial circles elsewhere. Correspondents
of S.E. Levy & Co. are stationed in New York, London, Manila,
Hongkong and other big cities.

In recent years it has been the policy of the Company
to expand and it is in this connection that it is proposed to
send representatives to Singapore. The agents chosen, Mr.
A.J. Corot alias Koroth and Mr. R.O. Kopelman, are both Russian
Jews. The former is the son of Mr. J.R. Koroth, a suspected
Soviet agent, but against Mr. Corot himself nothing detrimental
is known.

Mr. R.O. Kopelman is a man of good character who was
born in Shanghai and educated at Clifton College, England;
nothing is known to his detriment.

With regard to S.E. Levy & Co.'s standing in Police
estimation it may be said that this firm has never appeared in
an unfavourable light.

D.S. Henchman
D. S.
D. C. (Special Branch)

报告
日期：1937年7月19日

主题：S.E. Levy & Co. —— 英国总领事馆的查询。

制作人：D.S. Henchman 转呈人：G Crawford D.S.

S.E. Levy & Co. 是一家位于九江路113号的投资银行及证券商品经纪公司，于1933年7月以该名称成立；在此之前，该行名为 V. Gensburger & Co.。

该公司主要由犹太人组成，财务状况良好，在此地及其他地方的金融圈均享有极佳声誉。S.E. Levy & Co. 的通信代表驻于纽约、伦敦、马尼拉、香港和其他大城市。

近年来，该公司的政策一直是扩张，正是基于此背景，拟派遣代表前往新加坡。所选代理人 A.J. Corot 先生（别名 Koroth）和 R.O. Kopelman 先生均为俄罗斯犹太人。前者是 J.R. Koroth 先生之子，后者是一名疑似苏联代理人，但对 Corot 先生本人而言，并未发现任何不利情况。

R.O. Kopelman 先生品行端正，出生于上海，并在英国克利夫顿学院接受教育；未发现对其不利的情况。

关于 S.E. Levy & Co. 在警方评估中的地位，可以说该行从未以不利形象出现。

D.S. Henchman
D. S.
D. C. (特科)
〔此处有手写批注及签名，难以辨认〕
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

Shanghai Municipal Police
Headquarters.
Date 13th July 1937

D.C.Crime.,

Sir:

S.E.Levy & Co., brokers 113 Kiukiang Road wish to
open an agency in Singapore and for that purpose are sending
two Russian representatives thereto. The British Authorities
(Consul-General, Shanghai) request any information we may
possess as to the firm's standing in Police estimation.

（左侧批注：S.1. / For attention / DCR / 13/7）
（手写批注：Sp. Br. / For your assistance / please.）

Wmack Dormott

刑事处处长，

先生：

S.E.Levy & Co.，经纪商，地址九江路113号，希望在新加坡开设代理机构，为此将派遣两名俄罗斯代表前往该地。英国当局（上海总领事）请求我方提供所掌握的关于该行在警方评估中地位的任何信息。

（左侧批注：S.1. / 供注意 / DCR / 13/7）
（手写批注：特科 / 请予协助。）
